author: ojiudezue
title: v5.108.22 shipped: Release batch 2: read API ship 2, scoped egress mute, perimeter labels, stream health S2, BLE person registry resolve
summary: Release batch 2: read API ship 2, scoped egress mute, perimeter labels, stream health S2, BLE person registry resolve
why: Batch 2 bundles five reviewed cycles so the house takes one restart. The global egress mute silenced every perimeter camera for 120 s after any door event (40% of edges dropped, no rows), so it is scoped per door with a cover map and recorded as gate decisions. Stream health S2 applies the operator rule that a dead camera is faulty equipment: a dead input holds instead of reading off, capped at a measured 900 s, so a camera death alone cannot empty a zone or fire AWAY. The read API ship 2 gives consumers one public census read and a guard against private reads, the read half of the person-awareness layer. The BLE registry fix ends name matching that gave three people twelve sensors on other phones. All passed the full name-diff against 4b1d392b with zero new failures plus the D7 and mutation gates.
implications: Shipped PERSON-AWARENESS-READ-API-1, PERIMETER-GLOBAL-EGRESS-MUTE-1, PERIMETER-SWITCH-LABELS-AND-FLOW-PARITY-1, CAMERA-STREAM-DEAD-ZONE-AND-CENSUS-1, BLE-PERSON-SENSOR-REGISTRY-RESOLVE-1 at v5.108.22; card(s) sit shipped_organic pending validation. Acceptance in README_v5.108.22.md (Live criteria).
revisit_trigger: Live: egress_mute_covers loaded (3 doors) and perimeter_gate_decision rows appear; bermuda_resolve shows unresolved 0 for home residents; no camera_stream_hold_released page without a real outage; layer ship 3a builds next.
